name: pdf-viewer
title: PDF Viewer
description: PDF preview with page navigation, zoom, rotation, download, and optional field overlays (positioned highlights with labels). Wraps react-pdf with the pdf.js worker preconfigured. Use for ANY PDF viewing instead of <iframe>, <object>, react-pdf, or pdfjs directly.
docs: Import { PdfViewer } from '@/components/ui/pdf-viewer'. The container MUST have a defined height (e.g. <div className="h-[600px]">). Field overlays: pass fields=[{ name, x, y, page, width?, height?, label?, type? }] (page is 0-indexed) plus showAll or showFields={['name']}; showLabels displays names above overlays; onPageChange receives the 1-based page number. See the file-parsing skill for the full API.
